To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) stream flow fluctuations exhibit time irreversibility; (2) the time irreversibility is associated with nonlinearity; (3) stream flow fluctuations are characterized by a subexponential degree distribution; (4) the subexponential behavior is associated with non-linear long-range dependence.
stream flow fluctuations are highly nonlinear and nonstationary processes that are irreversibile and exhibit long range dependence.
Irreversibility and nonlinearity are two key features of stream flow dynamics that can be quantified using directed horizontal visibility graphs.
